title: PROJECTIVE PSYCHOLOGICAL ASSESSMENT OF LARGE MULTIMODAL MODELS USING THEMATIC APPERCEPTION TESTS

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the visual-based Thematic Apperception Test (TAT) and evaluating the generated narratives using the Social Cognition and Object Relations Scale - Global (SCORS-G) framework, where social desirability bias is inferred from the models' tendency to avoid hostile or morally conflictual content (resulting in low scores on aggressive impulses, moral standards, and self-esteem dimensions).
